q: We planned a two-week _____ to the beach for our summer holiday.
translation: 我们计划了一个为期两周的假期去海滩过暑假。

q: The small village lies in a green _____ between two high mountains.
translation: 这个小村庄坐落在一个位于两座高山之间的绿色山谷里。

q: This old ring is very _____ because it belonged to my grandmother.
explain: valuable adj. 有价值的；珍贵的。
translation: 这枚旧戒指非常珍贵，因为它是我祖母传下来的。

q: The _____ of the house has increased by twenty percent this year.
translation: 这栋房子的价值今年上涨了百分之二十。

q: She always _____ honesty more than money in her personal life.
explain: value v. 重视。第三人称单数 values。
translation: 她在个人生活中始终重视诚实胜过金钱。

q: There is a wide _____ in temperature between day and night here.
translation: 这里昼夜温差有很大的变化。

q: The store sells a large _____ of fresh fruits and vegetables daily.
translation: 这家商店每天出售大量各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

q: The museum has _____ kinds of art from many different countries.
translation: 博物馆有来自许多不同国家的各种艺术品。

q: The price of fresh fish _____ depending on the season and weather.
explain: vary v. 变化。第三人称单数 varies。
translation: 鲜鱼的价格因季节和天气而变化。

q: She put the fresh flowers in a tall glass _____ on the table.
translation: 她把鲜花放在了桌上一个高高的玻璃花瓶里。

q: The desert is a _____ area of sand that stretches for miles.
translation: 沙漠是一片广阔的沙地，绵延数英里。

q: Eating at least one green _____ every day is good for your health.
translation: 每天至少吃一种绿色蔬菜对健康有益。

q: A large _____ blocked the narrow road and caused a long traffic jam.
translation: 一辆大型车辆堵住了狭窄的道路，造成了长时间的交通堵塞。

q: The concert _____ was changed to a larger hall because of high demand.
translation: 由于需求量大，音乐会场地被改到了更大的礼堂。

q: The movie _____ of the book was quite different from the original story.
translation: 这本书的电影版本与原作故事有很大不同。

q: The _____ of the accident was taken to the hospital immediately.
translation: 事故的受害者被立即送往医院。

q: The team celebrated their _____ with a big party after the game.
translation: 球队在赛后举行盛大派对庆祝胜利。

q: We watched a short _____ about the history of the ancient city.
translation: 我们看了一段关于这座古城历史的短视频。

q: They _____ the entire wedding ceremony with two cameras.
explain: video v. 录像。过去式 videoed。
translation: 他们用两台摄像机录制了整场婚礼。

q: The hotel room has a beautiful _____ of the mountains and lake.
translation: 酒店房间可以看到山和湖的美丽景色。

q: The painting was _____ by thousands of people at the museum.
explain: view v. 观看。过去式 viewed。
translation: 这幅画在博物馆被成千上万人观看。

q: The small _____ has only one shop and a school for local children.
translation: 这个小村庄只有一家商店和一所供当地孩子上学的学校。

q: The police are working hard to stop street _____ in the city center.
translation: 警方正在努力制止市中心的街头暴力。

q: She has played the _____ since she was six years old.
translation: 她从六岁起就开始拉小提琴。

q: The company held a _____ meeting because everyone worked from home.
translation: 公司举行了虚拟会议，因为大家都在家办公。

q: Patience is a _____ that helps you succeed in difficult situations.
translation: 耐心是一种能帮助你在困境中取得成功的美德。

q: A computer _____ can destroy important files on your hard drive.
translation: 计算机病毒可能破坏你硬盘上的重要文件。

q: The stars are clearly _____ on a dark night away from city lights.
translation: 在远离城市灯光的黑夜中，星星清晰可见。

q: The leader had a clear _____ of how the city should look in ten years.
translation: 这位领导人对城市十年后的面貌有清晰的愿景。

q: During our _____ to the zoo, we saw many rare animals.
translation: 在我们参观动物园期间，我们看到了许多珍稀动物。

q: We _____ the old castle and learned about its interesting history.
explain: visit v. 参观。过去式 visited。
translation: 我们参观了古堡，了解了它有趣的历史。

q: The museum welcomes thousands of _____ from around the world.
translation: 博物馆每年欢迎成千上万来自世界各地的参观者。

q: The report includes many _____ aids like charts and pictures.
translation: 报告包含许多视觉辅助工具，如图表和图片。

q: The presentation included a powerful _____ that explained the idea clearly.
translation: 演示文稿中包含一个强有力的视觉资料，清晰地解释了这个概念。

q: Clean water is _____ for the health of all living things on Earth.
translation: 清洁的水对地球上所有生物的生存至关重要。

q: The artist used _____ colors to make the painting look full of life.
translation: 艺术家使用了生动的色彩，使画作充满活力。

q: Reading books is one of the best ways to build your English _____.
translation: 阅读是积累英语词汇的最佳方式之一。

q: The singer has a beautiful _____ that fills the entire concert hall.
translation: 这位歌手拥有美丽的嗓音，充满了整个音乐厅。

q: Several parents _____ their concerns about the new school policy.
explain: voice v. 表达。过去式 voiced。
translation: 几位家长表达了他们对新学校政策的担忧。

q: The _____ erupted last year and sent ash high into the sky.
translation: 这座火山去年喷发，将火山灰高高地送入天空。

q: Our school team won the _____ match against the visiting team.
translation: 我们校队在对阵客队的排球比赛中获胜。

q: Please turn down the _____ of the music; it is too loud for me.
translation: 请把音乐的音量调低，对我来说太响了。

q: The _____ helped serve food to the homeless at the shelter.
translation: 这名志愿者在收容所帮忙为无家可归者提供食物。

q: She _____ to help clean up the park after the festival ended.
explain: volunteer v. 自愿。过去式 volunteered。
translation: 节日结束后，她自愿帮忙清理公园。

q: The final _____ was very close, with only ten votes between the two sides.
translation: 最终投票结果非常接近，双方仅差十票。

q: The committee _____ to accept the new plan by a large majority.
explain: vote v. 投票。过去式 voted。
translation: 委员会以绝大多数投票通过了新计划。
